name: Singapore Airlines Limited
summary: Singapore Airlines Limited, together with subsidiaries, provides passenger and cargo air transportation services under the Singapore Airlines and Scoot brands in East Asia, Europe, South West Pacific, the Americas, West Asia and Africa, and internationally. It operates through The Full-Service Carrier, The Low-Cost Carrier, and Engineering Services segments. The company offers engineering services, pilot training services, air charters, and related services; tour activities; refurbishes aircraft galleys; payment and lifestyle reward app; and sells merchandise.
